Class OBJModel

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.loader3d.MeshModel
com.eco.bio7.loader3d.OBJModel
public class OBJModel extends com.eco.bio7.loader3d.MeshModel
A model of an OBJ file (with the materials and textures of the MTL file), centered and scaled to a size. The file is read with the MeshReader (also polygons, negative indices and vertex colors), see MeshModel for the other formats.

  • Constructor Details

    • OBJModel

      public OBJModel(String nm, String path, float sz, com.jogamp.opengl.GL2 gl, boolean showDetails)
      Loads the OBJ file path + nm + ".obj".
      Parameters:
      nm - the name of the file without the extension
      path - the directory (with a separator at the end)
      sz - the size of the largest dimension in the 3D view
      gl - the OpenGL context (not used, the model is drawn with draw)
      showDetails - prints the checks of the mesh
      Throws:
      UncheckedIOException - if the file can't be read

    • OBJModel
